title: Strapi IPFS Provider
tagline: IPFS (Filebase, Pinata, Fleek, Web3) provider for Strapi uploads.
how_its_made:
The documentation of all IPFS providers (web3.storage, pinata.cloud, filebase.com, fleek.co) was studied to understand how to work with requests.
Also, in order to understand the principle of file uploading in the Strapi control system, the documentation on creating a uploaded provider was studied.
